description.en: ID of the A-number group. On the [Qualification Management](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/qualification) page, click View Details in the A-number whitelist section of the relevant qualification.

description.zh: 证件类型，填写1表示身份证。
description.en: Certificate type. Enter 1 for an ID card.

description.zh: 正面人像照片OSS路径地址。
description.en: OSS path of the front-facing portrait photo.

description.zh: 身份证反面（人像面）照片OSS路径地址。
description.en: OSS path of the photo of the back side (portrait side) of the ID card.

description.zh: 身份证正面（国徽面）照片OSS路径地址。
description.en: OSS path of the photo of the front side (national emblem side) of the ID card.

description.zh: 备注（用户自身的业务备注）。
description.en: Remark (business remark added by the user).

title.zh: 提交A号码手机号个人实名信息
title.en: Submit Individual Real-name Information of an A-number Mobile Phone Number

descriptions.zh:
在调用此接口前，您需要先调用[GetDyplsOSSInfoForUploadFile](~~2880885~~)将个人照片信息上传至OSS，具体操作流程请参见[API提交A号码手机号个人实名信息](~~2880077~~)。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before invoking this API, you must first call [GetDyplsOSSInfoForUploadFile](~~2880885~~) to upload the individual's photo information to OSS. For the detailed operation flow, see [Submit Individual Real-name Information of an A-number Mobile Phone Number via API](~~2880077~~).
### QPS Limit
The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 50 requests per second per user. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to Rate Limiting, which may Impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
